title: computer-mascot/command
description: One command for the animated computer mascot. Vocabulary is inherited from talking_visualization's VoiceDirector so a single command stream can drive either surface.

action.description: presence = what the interface is doing now; emotion = the character of one idea; expression = both at once; cue = a brief gesture.

presence.description: Set only when the conversational state changes. Silence does not prove thinking, so thinking and confused must be set intentionally.

emotion.description: Hold one emotion for a complete thought or paragraph.

cue.description: A 100-1500ms gesture. Use at most one or two per paragraph; reserve impact for real emphasis.
